formal_statement: ¬ (have x1 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) := {(0 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ))}; ∀ (x2 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (x3 x4 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) (x5 : ℕ → Bool),   (∀ (x6 : ℕ) (x7 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), x2.gates[x6]? = Option.some x7 → (x7.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ x7.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ ∃ (x9 : ℕ) (x10 : ℕ), x7.inputs = [x9, x10] ∧ x9 ≠ x10 ∧ x9 < (26 : ℕ) + x6 ∧ x10 < (26 : ℕ) + x6) →     (∀ (x7 : Fin (26 : ℕ) → Bool), x2.eval (List.ofFn x7) = Bool.true ↔ ∃ (x8 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) (x9 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x8 - x9 ∈ x1 ∧ x7 (Fin.castAdd (13 : ℕ) x8) = Bool.true ∧ x7 (Fin.natAdd (13 : ℕ) x9) = Bool.true) →       PEqualNP.TopForm.andPairs (26 : ℕ) x2 = (0 : ℕ) →         x3 - x4 ∈ x1 →           (∀ (x10 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x5 ↑x10 = Bool.false ∧ x5 ((13 : ℕ) + ↑x10) = Decidable.decide (x10 = x4)) →             (have x11 : List Bool := x2.wires (List.ofFn fun (x11 : Fin (26 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x11 = Fin.castAdd (13 : ℕ) x3));               ∀ (x12 : ℕ) (x13 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (x14 x15 : ℕ), x2.gates[x12]? = Option.some x13 → x13.inputs = [x14, x15] → (x13.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and → x5 ((26 : ℕ) + x12) = (x11.getD x14 Bool.false && x5 x15 || x5 x14 && x11.getD x15 Bool.false)) ∧ (x13.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or → x5 ((26 : ℕ) + x12) = (x5 x14 || x5 x15))) →               x5 x2.output = Bool.true)
plain_statement: It is false that: Plane of order 3. A circuit of AND and OR gates, each reading two different earlier wires, that computes the incidence function and has no AND gate inside the cone of another AND gate. Then every incident point-line pair is reached by a proof tree with exactly one line leaf (its line, read once).
